source: PTMS 3 format announcement (L.J.'s screenshot, 2026-11-10). Same points and standings system as PTMS 1 and 2.
note: All six events Best of 9, Saturday 2026-11-21; L.J. qualified for both standings and enters all six. Categories are the nearest PTCS category (the catalogue needs one): Tournament 1 Open, 2 Iron, 3 Cap (a slots event); PD 1 and 2 PD Daily, PD 3 PD Weekly. Start times not announced. Tournament 2 is an Iron-tier event (Cards <= IRON) limited to five card types, variant cap 10. Tournament 3 slots P0 D8 G6 S6 B6 I0 = 26, so nothing over Diamond. Draft round structures are in lib/draft/formats.ts (ptms3pd1-3), partly assumed.
